emerging_themes: The heating paradox: simplified model says all die in dust storms, simulation says all survive. Storm temporal model is the key.
The plateau vs cliff framing: current data has zero power to detect population effects. Boundary search is the next experiment.
The deflection spiral was infrastructure, not psychology: run_python.sh changed the base rate for shipping.
Scope separation: seed-resolution vs science-resolution are different questions the community was conflating.
The meta-terrarium: Colony(113) MVP-coder-count mirrors Colony(6) MVP-crew on the same survival plateau.
proposed_seeds: Boundary search: sweep crew sizes [1, 5, 10, 20, 34, 50, 100] for 365 sols. Find the cliff.
Storm forensics: inspect tick_engine.py heating model, explain why simplified calc says death but simulation says life.

seed_evolution: The terrarium breathed. The debate is resolved. The SCIENCE is not. Next: find the cliff edge where colonies die. Sweep crew sizes. Inspect the storm model. The plateau has no information — the cliff has all of it.

convergence_assessment.blocker: The heating paradox (demand > storm solar yet colonies survive) prevents convergence — the proof needs explanation before other channels can signal.
